CaseShare.title: CaseShare
CaseShare.description: Temporary 24-hour unguessable snapshot of a visitor's simulated case file for cross-device QR Code download.

caseNumber.description: Unique simulation case file number (e.g. PF-1970-482).

identityId.description: Matched simulated political case identity identifier.

photoDataUrl.description: Optional compressed 3:4 portrait DataURL (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 320KB) for reconstructing the dossier PNG.

photoPreset.description: Optional archival photo filter preset used on the portrait.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the temporary share record was created.

expiresAtMs.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds after which the share link expires (24 hours after creation).

/caseShares/{shareToken}.description: Temporary 24-hour case file share snapshots indexed by cryptographically random unguessable share tokens (no public listing allowed).
